data.name: Saalim
data.gender_notes: Saalim is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Saalim is derived from the Arabic word 'saaalama', which means to be successful or lucky. In Islamic tradition, Saalim is associated with virtues such as kindness, justice, and bravery. The name Saalim carries the meaning “Successful, Lucky” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Saalim usually hope their child will grow to embody successful, lucky and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A person with the name Saalim is blessed with good fortune and is often considered a fortunate individual. They are also known for their sense of justice and compassion.
data.etymology: Saalim belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Successful, Lucky.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Saalim total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: سالم
in_arabic.meaning: سالم يعني من السلام والخير والنجاة من كل سوء
in_arabic.long_meaning: سالم هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و يعني الشخص الذي يتمتع بالسلام والخير والنجاة من كل سوء، وقد ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع كصفة للمتقين والمؤمنين، ويعتبر من الأسماء المحببة في الثقافة الإسلامية لما يحمله من معاني جميلة وروحانية عالية.

in_urdu.name: سالم
in_urdu.meaning: سالم کا مطلب ہے سلامتی، خیر، اور ہر برائی سے نجات
in_urdu.long_meaning: سالم ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے سلامتی، خیر، اور ہر برائی سے نجات۔ یہ نام قرآن کریم میں بھی ذکر ہوا ہے اور اسلامی ثقافت میں اس کی بڑی اہمیت ہے کیونکہ یہ نام اچھے اور خوبصورت معنی رکھتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: सालिम
in_hindi.meaning: सालिम का अर्थ है शांति, सुख, और हर बुराई से मुक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: सालिम एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है शांति, सुख, और हर बुराई से मुक्ति। यह नाम कुरआन में भी आया है और भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इसकी महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका है क्योंकि यह नाम अच्छे और सुंदर अर्थों से युक्त है।

in_pashto.name: سالم
in_pashto.meaning: سالم د سول، خير، او د هر ډول بدۍ څخه د نجات معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: سالم د عربي اصل نوم دی چې د سول، خير، او د هر ډول بدۍ څخه د نجات معنی لري. دا نوم د قرآن کريم په مختلفو ځايونو کې ذکر شوی او د افغان او پښتنو په کلتور کې ډیره اهميت لري ځکه چې ښه او مثبت مفهوم لري.

in_english.name: Saalim
in_english.meaning: Peaceful, safe, and free from harm or evil
in_english.long_meaning: The name Saalim originates from Arabic roots (س-ل-م) and signifies a person who enjoys peace, safety, and salvation from all harm or evil. Mentioned in the Quran as an attribute of the righteous and believers, the name holds significant spiritual and cultural importance in Islamic tradition, symbolizing serenity, goodness, and divine protection.

Thus, by giving a child the name Saalim, parents are acknowledging their hope for their child to embody such virtues and inspire others with their actions.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Saalim holds a special significance in Islamic tradition. The name alludes to the concept of striving towards moral excellence and righteousness in one's daily life. Muslims believe that being 'saalim' is a means to draw closer to God and to follow His commandments. By incorporating this name within a community, it serves as a reminder to continuously uphold good deeds, pleasant manners, and sincere intentions- attributes that contribute to an individual's spiritual growth and ultimately their connection with the Divine.
